verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order (wordmark, can, headline, body, CTA) in a clean centred stack, but the decorative circles have become small squashed ovals pushed into the corners. The CTA nearly touches both side edges, and there is a dead gap above it. B puts the headline above the SOLSTICE wordmark, which breaks the brand-to-message order. The headline also sits on top of the green circle, and the can is pushed down below the body copy, so the hero image comes after the message and the stack feels jumbled.
